title: Hummus Chicken Platter
shortDescription: Sliced spiced chicken over creamy hummus with veg and pita
subtitle: Sliced spiced chicken over creamy hummus with veg and pita
description: Spiced grilled or roasted chicken breast slices fan over a base of hummus with cucumber, tomato, olives, and warm pita for scooping.
equipment: Large serving platter or hotel pan

steps.title: Gather ingredients and equipment
steps.instruction: Line up every ingredient for Hummus Chicken Platter in the order you will cook — measure spices into ramekins, trim proteins on a dedicated board, and set tongs, thermometers, and hotel pans within arm's reach before any heat goes on.

steps.title: Preheat ovens and surfaces
steps.instruction: Preheat ovens, griddles, or grills to recipe temp before the crew arrives — cold equipment extends cook time and dries out batch chicken. Confirm burners ignite evenly and sheet pans are greased or lined.

steps.title: Make hummus base
steps.instruction: Blend chickpeas, tahini, half the lemon juice, 4 garlic cloves, cumin, and 2 tbsp olive oil until silky smooth, adding ice water as needed.

steps.title: Season and cook chicken
steps.instruction: Rub chicken with paprika, minced garlic, salt, and 2 tbsp oil. Roast at 425°F 18–22 minutes until 165°F with lightly charred edges.

steps.title: Rest and slice chicken
steps.instruction: Rest chicken 5 minutes, then slice ¼-inch against the grain. Slices should be moist with no pink center and clean cut edges. Hold covered at 140°F up to 20 minutes — log the time if your hall tracks food safety during long shifts. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early. Target 165°F at the thickest point before moving to the next batch.

steps.title: Assemble platter
steps.instruction: Spread hummus in a large pan, drizzle olive oil and paprika. Arrange chicken over hummus with cucumber, tomatoes, and olives around edges.

steps.title: Verify safe internal temps
steps.instruction: Spot-check the thickest pieces with an instant-read thermometer — target 165°F. If any piece reads low, return it to heat immediately rather than holding under temp on the line.

steps.title: Hold for call interruptions
steps.instruction: If tones drop mid-service, cover finished food and hold at 140°F in a warm cabinet or 200°F oven — never leave proteins below 140°F for more than 30 minutes cumulative. Note the hold time on the pan with a grease pencil.

steps.title: Portion and open the line
steps.instruction: Portion Hummus Chicken Platter onto sheet trays or hotel pans for family-style service. Stack plates, forks, and napkins at the end of the line so late-arriving crew can self-serve without bottlenecking the cook.

steps.title: Scale for larger halls
steps.instruction: When cooking for more than 8 firefighters, split into two pans halfway through so the bottom layer does not overcook while the top waits — duplicate mise en place if you double batches.

steps.title: Warm pita and serve
steps.instruction: Warm pita 5 minutes wrapped in foil at 300°F until soft and pliable. Serve for scooping hummus and chicken together. Keep a backup tray at 200°F for firefighters returning from a call — never serve picked-over pans to late crew. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early. Target 165°F at the thickest point before moving to the next batch.

proTips: Ice water in hummus makes it fluffier—add 2 tbsp at a time while blending.
Sumac sprinkle at the line adds tartness without extra prep.
Grill chicken on flat-top if oven is occupied—same spice rub works.
leftovers: Chicken and hummus wrap with extra cucumber.
Hummus dip with raw veg for next-shift snack.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Interactive platter format feels special but scales easily. High protein from chicken with fiber from hummus and veg.
mealPrepNotes: Make hummus smooth in a food processor ahead. Slice chicken against the grain for tender bites. Station: Spread hummus in a large shallow hotel pan for maximum scoop surface. Station: Arrange chicken in overlapping rows so portions look generous at the line. Station: Keep pita wrapped in foil in low oven until service.
